name: Control Center
author: bahman777
description: GNOME-style Quick Settings for Omarchy: a panel from the bar with toggles, sliders and in-place menus for Wi-Fi, network, Tailscale, Bluetooth, sound, displays, power, Hyprland layout, input, appearance, printers, scanners and system — every setting without leaving the panel.

barWidget.description: Status icons that open a GNOME-style Quick Settings panel.
